description: Elections Commission - Extra Ordinary Gazette No. 2312/33 dated 28.12.2022 is here by Amended, recognized Political Parties
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes by amending a previous gazette notice regarding recognized political parties for Local Authorities Elections. It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and Parliamentary Elections Act, and provides a schedule of registered political parties eligible for upcoming elections. This falls squarely under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns electoral matters, political party recognition, and election administration by the Election Commission.
